description: Rank 2-12 people for leading a kind of work (execution, people, innovation or analysis), showing the saved results behind each ranking and any thin data. Use for 'who should lead this project?'. Decision-support only. Read-only; costs 2 units.

department.description: Use everyone tagged with this department instead of naming members. Exact match first; refuses and asks for names if more than 12 people match or the name spans several departments.

kind.description: Kind of leadership the work needs.

members.description: Profile ids or full names of the people in the group (2-12). Omit when using department.

project.description: Optional project description echoed in the ranking.

name: suggest_lead
title: Suggest who should lead
